subject: [hw] opus-hevc -> D01: HEVC encode/decode facts for FACTS.md (facts/HEVC_ENC_PROTOCOL.md, facts/HEVC_DEC_NOTES.md)
body: [V] HEVC encode uses the same VENC core window and GCE transport as H.264: 78 GCE cmds per IDR at 320x240/640x480 (74 W, 2 R, WAIT_EVENT, MEM_MV), 80 at 1080p; start W 0x058=4 (HEVC_EncodeFrame drv 0x158a16), wait event 0x20 core0 / 0x24 core1 (0x158aa4-0x158ab0), ack W 0x060=4 (0x158b06), BYTE_CNT 0x098 via MEM_MV (0x158b8e). [V] VPS/SPS/PPS are software (HEVC_EncodeVPS/SPS/PPS 0x154fbc/0x155288/0x155ac0); HEVC_Encode{VPS,SPS,PPS}_HW (trigger 0x20/0x1/0x2) have no caller = dead. [V] register 0x000 bit 2 distinguishes codecs: HEVC_SetHWModeSel base 0x02000004 (0x157dd8), H264 base 0x0200bf60 (0x13e8b2); run values 0x0f68fff5 / 0x0f60bf70. [V] HEVC offsets all <= 0x12b0 (65 used in runs); HEVC-only: 0x038 0x0e4 0x180 0x184 0x190 0x194 0x114c 0x1150 0x1154 0x115c 0x1240 0x1244 0x1248 0x1250. [V 3 sizes] 0x024=(h16<<16)|w16, 0x114c=(coded_h<<16)|w (1088 at 1080p), 0x02c[15:0] = number of 32x32 CTBs. [V] vendor SPS/PPS: Main, CTB32, CB16, TB 8..16, intra depth 0, SAO on, PCM off, sign hiding on, cu_qp_delta on, transquant bypass off, transform skip off, deblocking override enabled; 1080p coded 1920x1088 + crop 8 lines. [V] HEVC RCPU firmware chosen by HEVC_GetRCCode (0x1567d4) among 10 ucHEVCRCPUCode_* images of 0x8040 B (table in HEVC_ENC_PROTOCOL.md section 5); which one a session takes [I]. [V] joined headers: VENC_PrependHeader (oal 0x228d0) memmoves the HW-written frame on the CPU with no invalidate -> mirror must be refreshed after each VENC GCE job (V40). DECODE: [V] HEVC SPS/PPS/VPS/VUI/SEI parsed in software (H265_RBSPGet*); slice header per element either software or HEVC_VLD barrel shifter (H265_parseSliceHeader 0xccfe0, 5th arg from H265_handleSLICENALU 0x8fc9e); HEVC_VLD reader = vdec_hal_read_hevc_vld (util 0x2c7dc) at 0x16028000 / LAT 0x16015000, index 0x26 ue, 0x27 se, n = n bits, 0 peek; HEVC decode waits via GCE (H265_GCE_WaitEvent 0xd4cf8, VDEC_EVENT_1 decode done) when inst+0xd0 set; whether set on the phone [I].
